description: Declared hotel loyalty entitlements — memberships, statuses, cards, certificates. Config, never inference: a perk is 'eligible' ONLY when its requirement key appears in held.* below; nothing downstream may guess an entitlement from a booking history, a name, or a card product. held.* lists are EMPTY until the user declares what they actually hold. purchasable[] declares acquisition paths the radar may surface (with the acquisition cost that must be included when such a perk is ever used in arithmetic). certificates[] is declared quantity ONLY — consumption state is a later phase and does not live in config.

purchasable.note: Free to join. Joining alone grants no elite status.

Paid annual InterContinental Ambassador membership. VERIFIED against the official T&C on 2026-08-28: purchase and renewal are each 'USD 225 or 45,000 IHG One Rewards points' — the points alternative is machine-encoded in acquisitionAlternatives (cash and points stay separate; the optimizer may choose either, never mix). This cost MUST be included whenever an Ambassador perk enters any later arithmetic. Purchase/renewal awards the annual Complimentary Weekend Night certificate.
